title: Christmas Morning Tater Tot Casserole
description: The Perfect Christmas Morning Casserole with tater tots, ham, cheese, and eggs.
steps: Pour the bag of tater tots into a 9x13 baking dish.
Add the diced or cubed ham over the tater tots.
Sprinkle the cheddar jack cheese evenly over the ham and tater tots.
In a mixing bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, sour cream, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder.
Pour the egg mixture evenly over the casserole ingredients in the baking dish.
Sprinkle additional cheese on top if desired.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for about 45 minutes until cooked through and bubbly.
